dedupe_keys.name: sipibel hospital and urban wastewater treatment and receiving water observations

description: SIPIBEL contains 48,439 measurements on 961 samples from hospital and urban wastewater, treatment streams, sludge and receiving waters. INSA Lyon, GRAIE and monitoring partners describe campaigns during 2011–2017 around Bellecombe, the Arve and Rhône rivers, Geneva groundwater and an additional Arcachon hospital site. Coverage includes treatment inlets and outlets, flow rates, analytical methods, pharmaceuticals, other chemical indicators, microbiology and ecotoxicity. These paired observations can support treatment-load and contaminant-fate simulations. Zenodo provides the deposit free under CC BY 4.0. Its current inventory lists a 7z archive and describes ten Excel files, while the article describes ten CSV tables and a PDF in a ZIP; that packaging discrepancy remains unresolved without downloading files. Site selection and intermittent campaigns are further limitations for transfer to other plants. model-dhi-west-wastewater-treatment-process-modelling and data-siaap-paris-wastewater-observatory-clichy are related resources. The earlier rejection for being site-specific overlooks this documented reuse; no treatment model was run.
